description: Use this when the user asks about one hotel: why it scores as it does, or whether it's quiet, clean or good for sleep or work. Returns the Comfort Score breakdown, what the scores rest on, the five must-haves, its strengths and complaints with the reason behind each score, price, the city tax where we know it and its okstays.com link. Pass focus with what the user asked about; detail='full' adds every scored signal (about four times longer). Read-only, no sign-in.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.

detail.description: summary (default) or full: every scored signal with its explanation, about four times longer.

focus.description: Signals the user asked about, as filter ids or names (e.g. ['quiet', 'bed', 'wifi']); always included with their reasons.

name: get_hotel
title: Hotel details
